h1: Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel — a tiny stay right by the pier, the easiest boat access on Koh Larn
intro: If you want a stay where you step off the boat and you're almost at your door, with no luggage to drag — Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel is a small 6-room place in Na Ban village, about 100 m from Na Ban Pier, giving you some of the easiest ferry access on the island. Rooms are simple, clean and air-conditioned, with free internet, and it's pet-friendly. Tawaen Beach and the Giant Buddha are a short ride away. It scores 7.7 from 3 reviews, from approx. ฿1,200/night.

body.html: What makes Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel appealing is its location right by Na Ban Pier. The stay sits only about 100 m from the pier, so once the ferry from Pattaya pulls in, it's just a short walk to your room — no songthaew ride or hauling bags up the hill like the beachfront stays. That makes it a great pick for a short island trip or for travelling light, when you want somewhere to drop your bags and head straight out.

The property is a small two-storey building with just 6 rooms, so it feels quiet and personal — more guesthouse than hotel. Rooms are air-conditioned with private bathrooms and free internet. A point several guests like: it's pet-friendly, which is still uncommon on Koh Larn. In reviews, location scores highest (around 8.0), thanks to being close to the pier, shops, and the village's eateries.
"Right next to the pier, very convenient — step off the boat and you can walk to it. Rooms clean enough for the price, and the owner was friendly."

Real guest reviews agree on two things: it's good value and easy to reach. The overall score sits at 7.7 — in the "pleasant" range — with location and cleanliness earning the praise, while rooms and service land in the middle, as you'd expect from a small budget stay. The upside is you don't pay much to sleep right by the pier, with A/C, internet, and food in the village within easy walking distance.

One thing to know before booking: this is not a beachfront stay. Despite the name echoing Tawaen Beach, the property is in Na Ban village on the pier side, not opening onto the sand. To swim at Tawaen or Samae Beach, you'll take a songthaew or rent a scooter (about 5–10 minutes). And as a small 6-room place, facilities are basic — there's no swimming pool or on-site restaurant like a larger resort.

Honestly, Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel is best for travellers who prioritise a convenient location and an affordable price over polish. If your picture is arriving by boat, stashing your bags quickly, renting a scooter to tour the beaches, then sleeping near the pier for an easy ferry home — it fits nicely. But if you want to wake up to a sea view, a pool, or a brand-new room, a stay on Tawaen or Samae Beach will suit you better.

On price, rooms start from approx. ฿1,200/night on weekdays. Weekends and long holidays push rates up and fill fast, since there are only 6 rooms — some platforms show peak rates climbing into the high two-thousands on busy days. If you're going on a holiday, book ahead and compare a few platforms (Agoda / Trip.com) to lock in a normal-season rate.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel, Koh Larn

faq.q: Where is Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel on Koh Larn?
faq.a: It's at 57 Moo 7, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri, in Na Ban village on the pier side · about 100 m from Na Ban Pier, making boat arrivals and departures very easy · it isn't on the beach, so to swim at Tawaen or Samae Beach you'll take a songthaew or rent a scooter (about 5–10 minutes).

faq.q: How much does Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel cost?
faq.a: From approx. ฿1,200/night on weekdays for a standard double · other room types and holiday dates cost more, and rooms sell out fast (only 6 rooms) · compare a few platforms (Agoda / Trip.com) before booking.

faq.q: Is Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel pet-friendly?
faq.a: Yes, it welcomes pets, which is still uncommon on Koh Larn · since there are only 6 rooms, flag it and confirm with the property at booking that you're bringing your dog or cat.

faq.q: Does Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel have a swimming pool?
faq.a: No, there's no pool · it's a small, simple 6-room stay focused on a convenient by-the-pier location and an affordable price, not full resort facilities · rooms are air-conditioned with free internet.

faq.q: How do I get to Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel?
faq.a: Take the ferry from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya to Na Ban Pier on Koh Larn (about 45 minutes) · from the pier it's only about a 100 m walk, no transfer needed · on the island, renting a scooter (~300 THB/day) is the easiest way to tour the beaches.

faq.q: Who is Koh Larn Tarn-Tawan Hotel best for?
faq.a: Best for travellers who prioritise a by-the-pier location and an affordable price, are on a short island trip or travelling light, want to drop their bags and head straight out, or want to bring a pet · less ideal if you need a step-onto-the-sand beachfront stay or a resort with a pool and full facilities.
